title: List caching hints
summary: A tool, a resource, a resource template and a prompt, so you can see the ttlMs and cacheScope hints (SEP-2549) on every list and read response.
about: Every list and read response carries a cache hint (SEP-2549): ttlMs, set to 60 seconds here.
There's one of each kind to list: a tool, a resource, a resource template and a prompt.
Look for ttlMs in each list response in the wire log.
